methods: B18 SAY IT IN ANOTHER LANGUAGE

proved_change: For Boolean uniform product null and coordinate resampling, bounded degree-D LDA gives |E_{T_rho P} f-E_U f| <= A sqrt(Var_U f)+sum_{|S|>D} rho^{|S|}|fhat(S)|.
Hence arbitrary-degree tests with exp(o(D)) Fourier support inherit bounded noised normalized advantage; polynomially sparse polynomials are covered at D=(log n)^{1+Omega(1)}.
The result extends to fixed finite uniform alphabets using unit-modulus tensor characters and support degree.
Polynomial-leaf decision trees have Fourier A-norm at most their leaf count and are ruled out as strong distinguishers when rho^D times leaf count vanishes.

Mao's successful rank-test acceptance function must have Fourier A-norm at least (1-o(1)) rho^{-(D_n+1)}, Fourier support exp(Omega(D_n)), and the same exponential obstruction persists under every fixed uniform approximation error below 1/2.
scope: Conditional/sufficient test-side framework for uniform finite-product nulls; not an unrestricted source solution and not a proof of the low-degree conjecture.
mao_boundary: Respected quantitatively: Mao satisfies exact low-degree matching but necessarily violates the spectral-simplicity condition by exponential Fourier-algebra complexity.
prior_art: Bounded-independence-plus-noise and Fourier spectral-norm/decision-tree methods are classical; Hsieh et al. and Chen-Li remain positive comparators. Novelty of the source-directed robust synthesis is UNVERIFIED.
remaining_gap: Extend explicit test-side control beyond small Fourier A-norm/sparse representations, ideally using product/read-once Fourier-tail bounds or signed S_n graph-orbit cancellation, while retaining bounded rather than zero LDA and still excluding Mao.
next_attack: Robustify sharp bounded-independence-plus-noise product/read-once tail theorems from exact moment matching to bounded LDA.
Develop a signed noise-weighted S_n graph-shape norm that exploits cancellations within large monomial orbits.
Localize Mao's mandatory Fourier mass by degree to identify the exact forbidden spectral window.
